strategies.name: cardoza_trendline_support_pullback
strategies.description: Strategy 1 of the book: in an uptrending growth asset, buy when price dips to trendline support while the slow MA is above the fast MA and the bar opens above the fast MA; sell at resistance.

source.quote: Stocks are purchased when the slow moving average exceeds the fast moving average

decisions: The book's MA lengths for this system are in a missing code figure; reused the 22/34 lengths the book reports for its MA system (p. 30). SMA chosen because the book defines MAs as simple averages (p. 24).
Kept the literal condition 'slow MA exceeds fast MA' (a pullback state) plus 'open > fast MA' exactly as written on p. 26, even though it reads oddly.
Trendline support approximated by the 20-bar lowest low: low within 1% of it. This is a horizontal support, not the book's sloped, forward-projected trendline.
Book only trades growth/uptrending stocks; approximated with trend_structure >= 0 (not in a lower-highs/lower-lows downtrend).
Book has no stop; author says it needs one (p. 35-36). Used stop below the 20-bar lowest low.
Exit at resistance approximated by a 2R target; time stop 20 bars ~ the 'several days to several weeks' swing horizon (p. 25).
uncodable: CANSLIM fundamental selection (earnings growth, new products, institutional ownership, market cap > $80B)
Short side of the stop-and-reverse 'smoothies' system (short at resistance)
Walk-forward re-optimization of hold time per stock
Not coded yet: rising_trendline_support(start_bar, end_bar, project_to_bar) — value of a trendline through swing lows projected to the current bar (TradeStation TLValueEasy)
Not coded yet: trendline_resistance(start_bar, end_bar, project_to_bar) as an exit level
Not coded yet: universe_filter: 30d return > 5% and 365d return > 10% (CANSLIM-style momentum screen, 2 of 3 with ownership proxy)

strategies.name: cardoza_sma_crossover_22_34
strategies.description: Strategy 2 of the book: buy when the fast SMA crosses above the slow SMA, exit when it crosses back under; lengths optimized per asset (BA optimum 22/34 days).

source.quote: when the fast crossed over or under the slow, then a trade is initiated

decisions: Used the book's reported BA optimum: fast 22, slow 34 days (p. 30). The book optimizes these per asset within 1-35; a per-asset walk-forward optimization should replace the fixed values.
SMA chosen because the book's MA definition is the simple average (p. 24).
Book has no protective stop; added a 3x ATR(14) stop since the author says stops are needed (p. 35-36).
The real exit is fast SMA crossing under slow SMA; grammar lacks that, so closest allowed trailing exit close<ema50 is used as an approximation (slower than the book's exit).
uncodable: Short side (crossing under as a short entry) — book says the system is not designed for shorting (p. 21)
Not coded yet: per_asset_walk_forward_optimization(fast in 1..35, slow in 1..35)

strategies.name: cardoza_smoothies_range_support_buy
strategies.description: Generic 'smoothies' support/resistance trade from the book's overview: buy when price reaches support expecting a rise, sell when it reaches resistance.

source.quote: When the price level reaches the support, the trader can assume the price will rise

decisions: Support = 30-bar lowest low; a 'touch' = low within 0.5% of it while the bar closes back above it (support holds).
Book says the simple version uses moving averages to confirm the price is increasing (p. 24); approximated with close > sma(50).
Exit at resistance approximated by a 2R target; resistance would be highest_high(30). 3% stop chosen because the book gives none.
Time stop 30 bars as a swing-length cap.
uncodable: Short at resistance / stop-and-reverse half of the system (p. 18)
Not coded yet: rising_trendline_support for the sloped version
